<thought>To determine the number of methyl groups, I will first obtain the 13C NMR spectrum of the sample using the carbon_nmr_spectra tool, which requires no arguments. The spectrum will show signals for methyl carbons (typically around 10‑30 ppm). By counting these signals, I can infer the number of methyl groups.</thought>
